description: Verifies VulnerablePower amount stacking semantics. Cultist has VulnerablePower(amount=4) (representing 4 stacks); player attacks for 6 raw → multiplier is still 1.5x (Python's Vulnerable returns the same VULNERABLE_MULTIPLIER regardless of stack count — duration vs strength) → 6 * 3/2 = 9 → cultist HP 48 - 9 = 39. The amount=4 round-trips through the parity exporter unchanged. A20 sibling (sts2-rs-k3y / sts2-rs-xpa): pins ascension=20 in metadata. Combat-side ascension is identity at python pin 01c094d (see docs/reality-checks/2026-05-12-ascension-audit.md), so the recorded trace is byte-identical to the A0 source except for metadata.ascension.
name: double-vulnerable-stack-seed0-a20
